create_sgd_optimizer: create a PyTorch SGD optimizer with configurable learning rate, momentum, weight decay, and Nesterov momentum
run_sgd_optimization_step: run a single SGD optimization step on model parameters with optional closure for loss recomputation
build_sgd_with_nesterov: build an SGD optimizer instance with Nesterov momentum for improved gradient-based convergence
test_sgd_functional_api: test the functional SGD API for batch computation over lists of tensors with foreach or single-tensor backends
review_sgd_momentum_dampening: review SGD momentum and dampening parameters for controlling velocity buffer updates during optimization
